subject: Arte
description_pt: Explorar diferentes elementos envolvidos na composição dos acontecimentos cênicos (figurinos, adereços, cenário, iluminação e sonoplastia) e reconhecer seus vocabulários.

components.description_pt: Identificar diferentes elementos envolvidos na composição de evento teatral como figurino, adereços e iluminação
components.description_en: Identify the different elements involved in theatrical event composition such as costumes, props, and lighting
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the effect of film techniques such as lighting or camera angles on meaning

components.description_pt: Reconhecer vocabulário específico associado a cada elemento de produção teatral
components.description_en: Recognize the specific vocabulary associated with each theatrical production element
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between general vocabulary and domain-specific vocabulary for a given topic

components.description_pt: Analisar como elementos de produção individual contribuem para evento teatral geral
components.description_en: Analyze how individual production elements contribute to the overall theatrical event
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how structural elements such as chapters, scenes, or stanzas contribute to overall meaning

cc_matches.description: Analyze the structure of texts, including how specific sentences, paragraphs, and larger portions of the text (e.g., a section, chapter, scene, or stanza) relate to each other and the whole.

Compare and contrast a written story, drama, or poem to its audio, filmed, staged, or multimedia version, analyzing the effects of techniques unique to each medium (e.g., lighting, sound, color, or camera focus and angles in a film).
Use precise language and domain-specific vocabulary to inform about or explain the topic.
